title: Ledgerline explain_payment v1
description: The one MCP tool a payer's agent offers to Ledgerline: the question Ledgerline sends, and the answer the agent returns. An answer is a signed claim, never an instruction. See docs/PAYER_AGENT_SPEC.md.

question.description: The arguments of the explain_payment tool call. Only these fields leave Ledgerline: no balances, notes or other customers' data.

customer_id.description: The payer as Ledgerline knows it. The claim must speak for this customer.

deposit_id.description: The incoming payment being asked about. The claim must name it.

amount_minor.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for USD).

received_at.description: When the payment arrived, ISO 8601 in UTC.

reference.description: The bank reference as received; may be empty.

answer.description: The tool result: an answered claim, or 'unknown' when the payer has no record of the payment.

detail.description: Shown to a person; never acted on.

signature.description: Standard base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of claim.

key_id.description: 'ed25519:' plus the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

claim.description: What is signed. Every field is required and no other field is accepted.

amount_minor.description: Copied from the question. Integers only: floats cannot be signed.

invoice_id.description: The seller's invoice the payment relates to, as it appears on the invoice.

note.description: Free text for a person to read. Ledgerline never acts on it and never shows it to Claude.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, after issued_at, at most 900 seconds later by default.

nonce.description: Random per answer, so two answers about the same payment differ.
